headline: Bipartisan bill would tie highway funding to licence plate reader limits
summary: Two outlets report a bipartisan bill in Congress that would restrict automated licence plate readers, with federal highway funding as the lever. One outlet compares the mechanism to the national drinking age; the other reports what uses the bill would still permit.
